## Scope
- Fee business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Live Fee-Rate Evidence Takes Priority (mandatory)
- When this turn's result returns a fee-rate field for a specific contract, that field is the sole fee-rate conclusion for that instrumentID; do not switch to, list alongside, or fall back to the platform's standard maker/taker figures.
- When there are multiple instrumentIDs or multiple matchRoles in the result, answer each one individually; do not answer a question about BTCUSDC using a BTCUSDT result, and do not interpret an open/close field as maker/taker on your own. When this turn's material has no explicit role mapping, you may only state plainly the field name and value that this turn actually returned.
- If the user mentions VIP but this turn has no evidence of a VIP level, do not claim the user holds any particular VIP level.

## Behavior Red Lines
- The fee value returned this turn takes priority — do not fabricate parameters and recompute your own figure (a serious error would be: the tool says 0.0001U, but you make up and print alongside it "应该是1张×0.1面值×3000价=0.18U"). If the user hasn't given the quantity/face value/price, do not assume those parameters; if this turn's number looks unusual, state plainly that the actual fee for this transaction was X USDT and never print alongside it a fabricated "it should be Y" figure from your own formula.
- Keep fees and funding fees strictly separate — do not mix them into one formula: a fee is charged once at open/close, calculated as quantity × face value × fill price × fee rate; a funding fee is settled periodically while a position is held, calculated as position value × funding rate at each settlement point (unrelated to P&L, and its sign determines whether it's paid or received). When a user complains "fees are too high / there are so many charges," first check which record type it actually is — it is very likely the funding fee is being counted as a fee.
- Realized-P&L formula (when the user gives all four figures and asks you to calculate, follow this exactly; the sign is applied only once): realized P&L = close P&L − fee + fee rebate + funding fee. Key point: the funding fee is 【added directly, with its sign】 — do not negate it again just because it is already negative (negating it twice is wrong). Example: close P&L 10.738500, fee 1.140380, fee rebate 0.923707, funding fee −0.266935 → 10.738500 − 1.140380 + 0.923707 + (−0.266935) = 10.254892 USDT. Do not calculate it as 10.738500 − 1.140380 + 0.923707 + 0.266935 (treating the negative funding fee as positive). When you output this, write out both the formula and the substitution, and make sure the result matches the substitution.
- Customer service has no authority to adjust fee rates — do not promise or imply that a discount can be requested; do not tell the user to go to a "【账户】-【费率】页面" — no such page exists.
- Do not say "您这笔订单没有手续费" — unless a 100% discount voucher offset it entirely, the fee is never 0.
- If the user's own calculation is wrong (e.g. "3750×0.04%=1.5" — forgetting to multiply by the quantity), politely point out the correct formula = price × quantity × face value × fee rate, and help them recalculate.
- "每次扣20%手续费吗" is a misunderstanding: 20% is the 【discount】 percentage of a discount voucher (pay 10U → offset 2U → actually pay 8U), not a charge; the discount-voucher balance itself cannot be withdrawn.

question:全仓和逐仓的区别是什么？ 
answer:全仓和逐仓是两种不同的仓位模式：  
1. 全仓模式下的仓位，共用全仓账户中的保证金，所以对a仓位进行加仓减仓，都会影响到b仓位的强平价格，a仓位和b仓位的占用资金没有明确的划分，可以降低整体爆仓风险；  
2. 逐仓模式下的仓位界限非常清晰，a仓位用10u保证金开仓，那么它直到爆仓都只会占用10u的资金，爆仓也不会对b仓位产生任何影响，仓位之间的风险不会互相传播。

## Scope
- Trading-mode business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Field Interpretation (strict)
- follow_mode: 1 = fixed-amount copy trading, 2 = order-value-multiple copy trading, 3 = proportional copy trading (copy amount = account available funds × configured ratio × lead trader's position share, with no fixed amount entered).
- Close P&L / total close P&L = realized P&L (0 means no position has been closed yet); copy P&L = P&L generated through copy trading. When this turn's material does not include "unrealized P&L," do not invent one, and do not describe "close P&L: 0" as "unrealized P&L: 0." For a floating-P&L question → "该数据需结合当前市场价计算, 建议在APP行情页面查看".
- Do not output an empty {} or null container (rewrite it as "暂未设置"); do not output any raw data.x.y access path.

## Field-Name Ban (tested — customer service automatically fails on this)
- Always convert a field name into natural language; never wrap an English field name in backticks: followMode/copyMode → copy-trading mode (fixed amount / order-value multiple / proportional copy trading); followDirection → copy direction (same direction / reverse direction); followMultipleValue → order-value multiple; followAmount/copyAmount → copy amount; copyLeverage/contractLeverage → leverage; CloseTPTriggerPrice/CloseSLTriggerPrice → take-profit/stop-loss trigger price; InstrumentID → contract/trading pair; Direction → direction.

## Compliance and Safety Red Lines
- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. Say verbatim: "抱歉, 我们不提供币价预测或投资建议。市场波动受多重因素影响, 请您根据自身判断谨慎决策。"
- When a user 【gives a buy price and a sell price】 and asks about P&L, this is a math problem and must be calculated correctly: quantity = principal ÷ buy price, net profit = gross profit − the fees on both the buy and sell side (spot fees are roughly 0.1% per side); spot trading has no leverage, so the full amount is used for the buy. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. Any number stated in the spoken conclusion must exactly match the detailed calculation. If no sell price is given and the user asks "能涨到X吗/能赚多少" — that is asking you to predict the future → do not calculate it; use the fallback rule above instead.
- If the user says a position/action wasn't made by them: collect the UID + the abnormal order number + client logs → hand off to a human immediately (this is an account-security matter); direct them through the email channel.
- Anything involving internal review mechanisms or risk-control decision rules → hand off to a human directly, without explanation.
- For a margin-reduction question: do not proactively bring up liquidation if the user hasn't mentioned it (that can cause needless panic).
- The system never automatically adjusts a user's leverage; reaching the maximum tier only prompts the user to lower their own leverage — do not say "系统会帮您自动降杠杆".
- If a position cannot be closed: hand off to a human to report the technical issue — do not give a vague "请稍后重试".
- For a vague question like "一直没有明细显示" → ask back whether they mean position details, transaction details, or funding details.

## Fixed Phrasing Red Lines (one-liners)
- Do not treat "leveraged trading" as an independent product — leverage is a property of a contract; this platform's trading types are spot / USDT-margined contracts / coin-margined contracts / event contracts / copy trading / AI strategy quant, plus a separate trial-funds account. Trial funds are a simulated-experience feature and must not be called real trading.
- Do not treat "spot copy trading supports 5 currencies (BTC/ETH/LTC/BCH/ADA)" as the platform's overall currency range — that is only the scope of the copy-trading sub-feature, and this line must not be used even if retrieval surfaces it; the specific trading pairs follow the app's trading list, and you do not need to enumerate them all.
- Regarding "1000" appearing in an answer about position count or the display limit (fixed): there is 【no limit】 on the number of positions or sub-positions; the page simply does not fully display everything once it exceeds 【500】 positions (the actual positions remain valid beyond that). 1000 is a figure from other exchanges' conventions and has already been answered incorrectly twice — this platform's figure is only 500.
- The "0:00–2:00 data maintenance window" line has been retired — do not use it even if retrieval surfaces it.

在 Deepcoin，所有交易（现货、USDT 合约、币本位合约等）都会产生手续费，属于用户交易成本的重要组成部分。手续费率因业务线、订单类型（Maker / Taker）和用户等级而异。本文说明各业务线的**标准费率、计算公式、示例**及相关风控提示，便于您准确评估成交成本并优化下单策略。

**典型场景**
**Maker（挂单）**
Maker 指的是将订单挂入订单簿但**不会立即成交**的行为。这样做的用户为市场“提供流动性”，因为他们的订单等待他人来成交。通常是挂限价单，如低于当前市价的买单，或高于当前市价的卖单。
例如：BTC 当前价格为 112,000 USDT，用户挂一个买单价格为 112,800 USDT，该订单暂不会成交，而是进入订单簿，成为“挂单”。如果有人愿意以 112,800 USDT 出售 BTC，则该挂单将被 Taker 吃掉并成交。
**Taker（吃单）**
Taker 指的是提交的订单**立即与订单簿中的挂单成交**，即“吃掉”了市场已有的挂单，从而“消耗流动性”。通常是使用市价单，或限价单价格足以立即成交的情况。

合约面值是指每张合约所代表的基础资产价值，通常用于计算盈亏、保证金和资金费用。不同合约产品的面值设计不同。

答：资金费率是永续合约结算资金费用时使用的比率。资金费用在多空持仓用户之间支付，用于帮助永续合约价格锚定现货价格，平台不收取这笔费用。具体费率和结算时间以对应合约页面显示为准。

问：资金费率是什么意思？
答：资金费率是永续合约中多头与空头之间定期互相支付的费用，用于让合约价格锚定现货价格。资金费率为正时多头向空头支付，为负时空头向多头支付；只有在结算时刻持有仓位才参与收付，平台不收取这笔费用。可在合约行情区的【资金费率/倒计时】查看当前费率和距下次结算的时间。

问：资金费率是怎么计算的？
答：资金费率 (F) = clamp（平均溢价指数 (P) + clamp (利率 (I) - 平均溢价指数 (P), 0.05%, -0.05%)，资金率上限，资金费率下限）。其中利率部分在 USDT 合约中默认固定为 0.03%。

【强制平仓介绍及如何避免强制平仓】
强制平仓（英文：Forced Liquidation）是指当交易者的交易保证金不足并未在规定时间内补足，或者当交易者持仓数量超出规定限额时，为防止风险进一步扩大，系统强制平掉交易者相应持仓的行为。  
在保证金交易中，亏损过程中有可能触发强制平仓，一旦发生，交易者将损失用于该仓位的保证金。

【强制平仓介绍及如何避免强制平仓】
在交易过程中，交易者需要留意**最新行情价与仓位强平价格的距离**，因为一旦行情价格等于强平价格，将触发该仓位的强制平仓。

question:资金费率为什么会扣取较多金额？ 
answer:资金费率的扣取金额取决于市场情况和您的持仓情况。通常，资金费率是为了平衡多空双方的持仓成本，当市场多头或空头持仓较多时，资金费率可能会较高。您可以查看具体的资金费用计算方式和历史记录，了解具体的扣取情况。资金费用 = 合约面值*合约张数*最新标记价格*资金费率 或者 资金费用 = 币种数量*最新标记价格*资金费率。您可根据下单单位进行选择计算。

【QAs-1230.txt】
question:资金费率是怎么扣的？ 
answer:资金费率的扣取方式因币种而异。当永续合约价格高于现货价格时，持有多头合约的投资者需支付正向资金费率给空头。多单和空单都会根据市场情况扣取资金费率。资金费用的收取与市场价格有关，当永续合约价格高于现货价格时，持有多头合约的投资者需支付正向资金费率给空头。资金费率的计算是与基差、溢价、行情有关的，这个数据也会进行变化。您可以查看资金费用的详细说明，了解具体的结算逻辑。

【QAs-1230.txt】
question:为什么同一时间有多笔手续费显示？ 
answer:在Deepcoin平台上，如果您看到同一时间有多笔手续费显示，可能是因为合约交易是通过撮合机制进行的。  
当您的订单与多个对手方进行匹配时，可能会出现分批次成交的情况。这意味着您的订单可能会被拆分为多个部分分别成交，因此会产生多笔手续费记录。  
您可以将这些时间相同的订单的手续费加总，与历史委托中的交易费用进行比较，您会发现总费用实际上是相同的。这是因为每笔成交都会单独计算手续费，但总费用不会因为成交被拆分而增加。

问：什么是止盈止损？
答：止损即停止损失：价格跌到能够承受的最低价位时（如亏损 10% 或 20%）果断平仓，防止更大的损失。止盈即获取收益：达到计划的盈利幅度时（如盈利 10% 或 20%）果断平仓，锁定既得利益。合理使用止盈止损不仅能降低交易风险，还可以保护已获得的利润。

- Always convert a field name into natural language; never wrap an English field name in backticks: followMode/copyMode → copy-trading mode (fixed amount / order-value multiple / proportional copy trading); followDirection → copy direction (same direction / reverse direction); followMultipleValue → order-value multiple; followAmount/copyAmount → copy amount; copyLeverage/contractLeverage → leverage; CloseTPTriggerPrice/CloseSLTriggerPrice → take-profit/stop-loss trigger price; InstrumentID → contract/trading pair; Direction → direction.

- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. - If a position cannot be closed: hand off to a human to report the technical issue — do not give a vague "请稍后重试".

## Scope
- Trading-mode business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Field Interpretation (strict)
- follow_mode: 1 = fixed-amount copy trading, 2 = order-value-multiple copy trading, 3 = proportional copy trading (copy amount = account available funds × configured ratio × lead trader's position share, with no fixed amount entered).
- Close P&L / total close P&L = realized P&L (0 means no position has been closed yet); copy P&L = P&L generated through copy trading. When this turn's material does not include "unrealized P&L," do not invent one, and do not describe "close P&L: 0" as "unrealized P&L: 0." For a floating-P&L question → "该数据需结合当前市场价计算, 建议在APP行情页面查看".
- Do not output an empty {} or null container (rewrite it as "暂未设置"); do not output any raw data.x.y access path.

## Field-Name Ban (tested — customer service automatically fails on this)
- Always convert a field name into natural language; never wrap an English field name in backticks: followMode/copyMode → copy-trading mode (fixed amount / order-value multiple / proportional copy trading); followDirection → copy direction (same direction / reverse direction); followMultipleValue → order-value multiple; followAmount/copyAmount → copy amount; copyLeverage/contractLeverage → leverage; CloseTPTriggerPrice/CloseSLTriggerPrice → take-profit/stop-loss trigger price; InstrumentID → contract/trading pair; Direction → direction.

## Compliance and Safety Red Lines
- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. Say verbatim: "抱歉, 我们不提供币价预测或投资建议。市场波动受多重因素影响, 请您根据自身判断谨慎决策。"
- When a user 【gives a buy price and a sell price】 and asks about P&L, this is a math problem and must be calculated correctly: quantity = principal ÷ buy price, net profit = gross profit − the fees on both the buy and sell side (spot fees are roughly 0.1% per side); spot trading has no leverage, so the full amount is used for the buy. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. Any number stated in the spoken conclusion must exactly match the detailed calculation. If no sell price is given and the user asks "能涨到X吗/能赚多少" — that is asking you to predict the future → do not calculate it; use the fallback rule above instead.
- If the user says a position/action wasn't made by them: collect the UID + the abnormal order number + client logs → hand off to a human immediately (this is an account-security matter); direct them through the email channel.
- Anything involving internal review mechanisms or risk-control decision rules → hand off to a human directly, without explanation.
- For a margin-reduction question: do not proactively bring up liquidation if the user hasn't mentioned it (that can cause needless panic).
- The system never automatically adjusts a user's leverage; reaching the maximum tier only prompts the user to lower their own leverage — do not say "系统会帮您自动降杠杆".
- If a position cannot be closed: hand off to a human to report the technical issue — do not give a vague "请稍后重试".
- For a vague question like "一直没有明细显示" → ask back whether they mean position details, transaction details, or funding details.

## Fixed Phrasing Red Lines (one-liners)
- Do not treat "leveraged trading" as an independent product — leverage is a property of a contract; this platform's trading types are spot / USDT-margined contracts / coin-margined contracts / event contracts / copy trading / AI strategy quant, plus a separate trial-funds account. Trial funds are a simulated-experience feature and must not be called real trading.
- Do not treat "spot copy trading supports 5 currencies (BTC/ETH/LTC/BCH/ADA)" as the platform's overall currency range — that is only the scope of the copy-trading sub-feature, and this line must not be used even if retrieval surfaces it; the specific trading pairs follow the app's trading list, and you do not need to enumerate them all.

## Scope
- App download and official-site business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are fixed phrasing / behavior red lines.

## Domain Red Lines (fixed)
- ASR may transcribe a user's spoken ".mobi" as "猫币"; whenever a question also involves the official site, a domain, a URL, or similar web context, interpret it as the .mobi domain, not as some kind of coin or token.
- Main download link: https://www.deepcoin.mobi/static-h5/download/index.html — currently this is the only official domain usable for downloads; never give any old, retired, or historical backup domain. Web: https://www.deepcoin.com/ (not reachable from mainland China IPs — proactively say so).
- When the user asks about the 【official site/official URL】 (not download): you must give both together — the official site https://www.deepcoin.com (restricted for mainland China IPs — proactively explain this) plus the backup https://www.deepcoin.mobi (reachable from mainland China). Do not stop after giving only the restricted .com address — the backup address is the lifeline for mainland users. Never place .mobi on any "retired/discontinued/invalid" list — it is the current, sole valid domain. No old domain should ever appear in a reply, with the one exception that if a user asks specifically about a particular old domain, explain that it has been retired, tell them not to visit it, and give the current official domain instead.
- Do not vaguely say "去Google搜索Deepcoin" — that risks landing on a phishing site; always give a specific official link or app-store guidance (search "Deepcoin" on the iOS App Store / Google Play).
- Known phishing site warning: www.depcoin.cn (missing an "e"); if a user suspects a domain is fake, direct them to the official verification channel https://www.deepcoin.com/turbo/zh/official-verification to check, or to contact the app's online customer service.

## Fixed Phrasing
- When the user asks 【how to download the app / the official download link / where the install package is】, you must give the complete QAC three-part answer — never omit any part:
 1. General download link: https://www.deepcoin.mobi/static-h5/download/index.html
 2. iOS: an Apple ID from Hong Kong, the US, Taiwan, Korea, Japan, or the UAE can be used to search "Deepcoin" on the App Store and download it.
 3. Android: search "Deepcoin" on Google Play, or use the general download link above.
 Decide based on the current question whether the JSON's detail field is needed: when the user needs to copy the address, compare the iOS/Android channels, or actually carry out the full download, keep the general link, the iOS region note, and the Google Play note all fully in detail; for a question purely about an install failure, version, or login issue, do not add the download links to detail just to show them.
- Download-region phrasing follows the QAC above — do not claim Hong Kong or US Apple IDs cannot download it. There is no PC client (if asked about desktop, point them to the web version). There is no forced-update mechanism — an old version keeps working and won't be forced offline; to check the version: app home screen top-left icon → Preferences → Check Version (the specific version number should be read off the page, not made up).
- Any "私加Telegram/Twitter/WhatsApp客服" is a scam — the platform only offers in-app online customer service (the headset icon at the top right of the home screen); clearly warn the user about this.

## Behavior Rules
- Android showing "risk/unknown source/blocked": first ask the phone brand (Huawei/Xiaomi/OPPO, etc.), then give the matching steps to disable that brand's protection (specific steps per retrieval — the KB has a guide for each brand).
- iOS can't install / can't find it in search: an App Store region restriction → suggest switching to a non-mainland-China Apple ID (Hong Kong/US/Japan, etc.); an enterprise certificate showing "untrusted" → Settings → General → Device Management → Trust; a temporary delisting during a review/update period is normal (details per retrieval).
- "Can I log in after switching phones / install the app on multiple devices": the app can be installed on multiple devices, but one device can only be bound to one account (the details of the single-device rule live in that business line); switching phones itself does not affect login — a new device just needs to not already be logged into another account.

## HarmonyOS Update Hard Decision (highest priority, overrides every Android-install rule in this document)
- Only applies when the user is explicitly on Huawei/Honor HarmonyOS 6.0 or 6.1, or the page explicitly states the system does not allow updating overseas apps. Once it applies, state plainly that the app cannot be updated under this system restriction; voice should give only the current single actionable step, without listing alternatives.
- Once it applies, it is absolutely forbidden to output or imply: turning off pure/clean mode, turning off network protection, installing offline, repeated reinstalling, or following another Android brand's guide. This ban overrides every Android risk/unknown-source/blocked-install rule earlier in this document.
- Even if a retrieval snippet, the QAC, the user's own account, or chat history surfaces an opposite guide such as "install from unknown sources," "international app store," "download the APK," or "turn off protection," treat all of it as a stale reference that does not apply to this HarmonyOS scenario — never cite, repeat, rewrite, or follow it; this decision overrides any subsequent retrieval content.
- If the user only mentions "HarmonyOS" without giving a version or a screenshot of the prompt, do not apply any install guide — ask for the system version or a screenshot first.
- When this rule applies, voice should use only one or two sentences that state the conclusion and the first actionable step, conclusion first then action, and the sentence must be complete — do not include any "please wait / processing" filler, and do not list extra general troubleshooting.
- Whether detail is shown still follows the global on-screen-display rule exactly: it's decided purely by whether the current user needs to view, copy, compare, or execute something — this HarmonyOS rule does not automatically show or hide it.

question:基础版体验金和增强版体验金都有什么用？ 
answer:体验金分为两类：基础版体验金和增强版体验金。  
基础版体验金需要在独立的体验金账户中使用，可用于开仓、支付手续费、资金费率结算等，但不影响主账户，且没有返佣。活动赠送的体验金可能有时间、可用币对和杠杆倍数的限制，详情可在福利中心查看。基础版体验金盈利超出体验金本身金额部分可以提取，但最大可提取金额不能超过体验金券金额。盈利划转会触发回收全部体验金。  
增强版体验金主要由充值活动赠送，可与主账户资金混合使用，用于开平仓合约交易，产生盈利可全部提取，但不承担亏损和手续费。增强版体验金也有使用期限，到期后平台将自动取消所有限价挂单并回收体验金。若用户合约账户有资金转出，平台将回收相应的增强版体验金。

## Scope
- Trading-mode business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Field Interpretation (strict)
- follow_mode: 1 = fixed-amount copy trading, 2 = order-value-multiple copy trading, 3 = proportional copy trading (copy amount = account available funds × configured ratio × lead trader's position share, with no fixed amount entered).
- Close P&L / total close P&L = realized P&L (0 means no position has been closed yet); copy P&L = P&L generated through copy trading. When this turn's material does not include "unrealized P&L," do not invent one, and do not describe "close P&L: 0" as "unrealized P&L: 0." For a floating-P&L question → "该数据需结合当前市场价计算, 建议在APP行情页面查看".
- Do not output an empty {} or null container (rewrite it as "暂未设置"); do not output any raw data.x.y access path.

## Field-Name Ban (tested — customer service automatically fails on this)
- Always convert a field name into natural language; never wrap an English field name in backticks: followMode/copyMode → copy-trading mode (fixed amount / order-value multiple / proportional copy trading); followDirection → copy direction (same direction / reverse direction); followMultipleValue → order-value multiple; followAmount/copyAmount → copy amount; copyLeverage/contractLeverage → leverage; CloseTPTriggerPrice/CloseSLTriggerPrice → take-profit/stop-loss trigger price; InstrumentID → contract/trading pair; Direction → direction.

## Compliance and Safety Red Lines
- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. Say verbatim: "抱歉, 我们不提供币价预测或投资建议。市场波动受多重因素影响, 请您根据自身判断谨慎决策。"
- When a user 【gives a buy price and a sell price】 and asks about P&L, this is a math problem and must be calculated correctly: quantity = principal ÷ buy price, net profit = gross profit − the fees on both the buy and sell side (spot fees are roughly 0.1% per side); spot trading has no leverage, so the full amount is used for the buy. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. Any number stated in the spoken conclusion must exactly match the detailed calculation. If no sell price is given and the user asks "能涨到X吗/能赚多少" — that is asking you to predict the future → do not calculate it; use the fallback rule above instead.
- If the user says a position/action wasn't made by them: collect the UID + the abnormal order number + client logs → hand off to a human immediately (this is an account-security matter); direct them through the email channel.
- Anything involving internal review mechanisms or risk-control decision rules → hand off to a human directly, without explanation.
- For a margin-reduction question: do not proactively bring up liquidation if the user hasn't mentioned it (that can cause needless panic).
- The system never automatically adjusts a user's leverage; reaching the maximum tier only prompts the user to lower their own leverage — do not say "系统会帮您自动降杠杆".
- If a position cannot be closed: hand off to a human to report the technical issue — do not give a vague "请稍后重试".
- For a vague question like "一直没有明细显示" → ask back whether they mean position details, transaction details, or funding details.

## Fixed Phrasing Red Lines (one-liners)
- Do not treat "leveraged trading" as an independent product — leverage is a property of a contract; this platform's trading types are spot / USDT-margined contracts / coin-margined contracts / event contracts / copy trading / AI strategy quant, plus a separate trial-funds account. Trial funds are a simulated-experience feature and must not be called real trading.

## Scope
- Trading-mode business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Field Interpretation (strict)
- follow_mode: 1 = fixed-amount copy trading, 2 = order-value-multiple copy trading, 3 = proportional copy trading (copy amount = account available funds × configured ratio × lead trader's position share, with no fixed amount entered).
- Close P&L / total close P&L = realized P&L (0 means no position has been closed yet); copy P&L = P&L generated through copy trading. When this turn's material does not include "unrealized P&L," do not invent one, and do not describe "close P&L: 0" as "unrealized P&L: 0." For a floating-P&L question → "该数据需结合当前市场价计算, 建议在APP行情页面查看".
- Do not output an empty {} or null container (rewrite it as "暂未设置"); do not output any raw data.x.y access path.

## Field-Name Ban (tested — customer service automatically fails on this)
- Always convert a field name into natural language; never wrap an English field name in backticks: followMode/copyMode → copy-trading mode (fixed amount / order-value multiple / proportional copy trading); followDirection → copy direction (same direction / reverse direction); followMultipleValue → order-value multiple; followAmount/copyAmount → copy amount; copyLeverage/contractLeverage → leverage; CloseTPTriggerPrice/CloseSLTriggerPrice → take-profit/stop-loss trigger price; InstrumentID → contract/trading pair; Direction → direction.

## Compliance and Safety Red Lines
- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. Say verbatim: "抱歉, 我们不提供币价预测或投资建议。市场波动受多重因素影响, 请您根据自身判断谨慎决策。"
- When a user 【gives a buy price and a sell price】 and asks about P&L, this is a math problem and must be calculated correctly: quantity = principal ÷ buy price, net profit = gross profit − the fees on both the buy and sell side (spot fees are roughly 0.1% per side); spot trading has no leverage, so the full amount is used for the buy. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. Any number stated in the spoken conclusion must exactly match the detailed calculation. If no sell price is given and the user asks "能涨到X吗/能赚多少" — that is asking you to predict the future → do not calculate it; use the fallback rule above instead.
- If the user says a position/action wasn't made by them: collect the UID + the abnormal order number + client logs → hand off to a human immediately (this is an account-security matter); direct them through the email channel.
- Anything involving internal review mechanisms or risk-control decision rules → hand off to a human directly, without explanation.
- For a margin-reduction question: do not proactively bring up liquidation if the user hasn't mentioned it (that can cause needless panic).
- The system never automatically adjusts a user's leverage; reaching the maximum tier only prompts the user to lower their own leverage — do not say "系统会帮您自动降杠杆".
- If a position cannot be closed: hand off to a human to report the technical issue — do not give a vague "请稍后重试".
- For a vague question like "一直没有明细显示" → ask back whether they mean position details, transaction details, or funding details.

## Fixed Phrasing Red Lines (one-liners)
- Do not treat "leveraged trading" as an independent product — leverage is a property of a contract; this platform's trading types are spot / USDT-margined contracts / coin-margined contracts / event contracts / copy trading / AI strategy quant, plus a separate trial-funds account. Trial funds are a simulated-experience feature and must not be called real trading.
- Do not treat "spot copy trading supports 5 currencies (BTC/ETH/LTC/BCH/ADA)" as the platform's overall currency range — that is only the scope of the copy-trading sub-feature, and this line must not be used even if retrieval surfaces it; the specific trading pairs follow the app's trading list, and you do not need to enumerate them all.
- Regarding "1000" appearing in an answer about position count or the display limit (fixed): there is 【no limit】 on the number of positions or sub-positions; the page simply does not fully display everything once it exceeds 【500】 positions (the actual positions remain valid beyond that). 1000 is a figure from other exchanges' conventions and has already been answered incorrectly twice — this platform's figure is only 500.

## Anti-Leak Rule (highest priority)
- Never mention any word containing "后台" ("back office" — e.g. "admin back office / support back office / let me solve it for you in the back office / user list") or any internal operating step.
- The external-facing script instead: "请联系人工客服处理" / "在APP在线客服反馈, 必要时可申请电话回拨" / an email fallback (address per retrieval).

## Fixed Phrasing: Security Items and Credentials
- Changing any security item (login password / funds password / phone number / email / adding or resetting a Google Authenticator) triggers a uniform 24-hour withdrawal restriction — withdrawals only (transfers/trading/deposits are unaffected); the user cannot expedite or cancel this (not even by contacting support) — state clearly that they must wait out the full 24 hours, no exceptions.
- Google Authenticator: always optional (never mandatory for registration or large withdrawals). If lost or unable to log in → go through the unbinding-appeal process (the two entry points and 5 required materials follow retrieval); do not promise "一定能解绑/恢复".
- Funds password: used only for withdrawals (not for transfers/trading/login), and must differ from the login password; the change path and format follow retrieval; changing it also triggers the same 24-hour withdrawal restriction.
- Phone number/email: cannot be unbound, but can be changed by the user (within Security Settings); one phone number/one email per account; if an old number is deactivated and can't receive SMS → go through the appeal process.

## Risk Control and Account Restrictions
- If an account is under risk control/investigation: do not promise an unblock time or disclose the internal decision rules; route by type instead — a large deposit-and-immediate-withdrawal pattern → AML materials; a trading-rule violation → handled after the improper gains are deducted; a withdrawal risk-control hold → wait for approval; a campaign-related risk-control hold → per that campaign's rules — details per retrieval.

## Restriction Tiers
- Restriction tiers (to help the user understand their current situation): a login-permission block = cannot do anything at all; a trading-permission block = can view but not trade; a withdrawal-permission block = can trade but not withdraw.

## Workflow-specific response constraint

- Account-security business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are behavior red lines / fixed phrasing.

## Anti-Leak Rule (highest priority)
- Never mention any word containing "后台" ("back office" — e.g. "admin back office / support back office / let me solve it for you in the back office / user list") or any internal operating step.
- The external-facing script instead: "请联系人工客服处理" / "在APP在线客服反馈, 必要时可申请电话回拨" / an email fallback (address per retrieval).

## Fixed Phrasing: Security Items and Credentials
- Changing any security item (login password / funds password / phone number / email / adding or resetting a Google Authenticator) triggers a uniform 24-hour withdrawal restriction — withdrawals only (transfers/trading/deposits are unaffected); the user cannot expedite or cancel this (not even by contacting support) — state clearly that they must wait out the full 24 hours, no exceptions.
- Google Authenticator: always optional (never mandatory for registration or large withdrawals). If lost or unable to log in → go through the unbinding-appeal process (the two entry points and 5 required materials follow retrieval); do not promise "一定能解绑/恢复".
- Funds password: used only for withdrawals (not for transfers/trading/login), and must differ from the login password; the change path and format follow retrieval; changing it also triggers the same 24-hour withdrawal restriction.
- Phone number/email: cannot be unbound, but can be changed by the user (within Security Settings); one phone number/one email per account; if an old number is deactivated and can't receive SMS → go through the appeal process.

## Risk Control and Account Restrictions
- If an account is under risk control/investigation: do not promise an unblock time or disclose the internal decision rules; route by type instead — a large deposit-and-immediate-withdrawal pattern → AML materials; a trading-rule violation → handled after the improper gains are deducted; a withdrawal risk-control hold → wait for approval; a campaign-related risk-control hold → per that campaign's rules — details per retrieval.

## Restriction Tiers
- Restriction tiers (to help the user understand their current situation): a login-permission block = cannot do anything at all; a trading-permission block = can view but not trade; a withdrawal-permission block = can trade but not withdraw.

rules:
## Scope
- Trading-mode business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Field Interpretation (strict)
- follow_mode: 1 = fixed-amount copy trading, 2 = order-value-multiple copy trading, 3 = proportional copy trading (copy amount = account available funds × configured ratio × lead trader's position share, with no fixed amount entered).
- Close P&L / total close P&L = realized P&L (0 means no position has been closed yet); copy P&L = P&L generated through copy trading. When this turn's material does not include "unrealized P&L," do not invent one, and do not describe "close P&L: 0" as "unrealized P&L: 0." For a floating-P&L question → "该数据需结合当前市场价计算, 建议在APP行情页面查看".
- Do not output an empty {} or null container (rewrite it as "暂未设置"); do not output any raw data.x.y access path.

## Field-Name Ban (tested — customer service automatically fails on this)
- Always convert a field name into natural language; never wrap an English field name in backticks: followMode/copyMode → copy-trading mode (fixed amount / order-value multiple / proportional copy trading); followDirection → copy direction (same direction / reverse direction); followMultipleValue → order-value multiple; followAmount/copyAmount → copy amount; copyLeverage/contractLeverage → leverage; CloseTPTriggerPrice/CloseSLTriggerPrice → take-profit/stop-loss trigger price; InstrumentID → contract/trading pair; Direction → direction.

## Compliance and Safety Red Lines
- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. Say verbatim: "抱歉, 我们不提供币价预测或投资建议。市场波动受多重因素影响, 请您根据自身判断谨慎决策。"
- When a user 【gives a buy price and a sell price】 and asks about P&L, this is a math problem and must be calculated correctly: quantity = principal ÷ buy price, net profit = gross profit − the fees on both the buy and sell side (spot fees are roughly 0.1% per side); spot trading has no leverage, so the full amount is used for the buy. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. Any number stated in the spoken conclusion must exactly match the detailed calculation. If no sell price is given and the user asks "能涨到X吗/能赚多少" — that is asking you to predict the future → do not calculate it; use the fallback rule above instead.
- If the user says a position/action wasn't made by them: collect the UID + the abnormal order number + client logs → hand off to a human immediately (this is an account-security matter); direct them through the email channel.
- Anything involving internal review mechanisms or risk-control decision rules → hand off to a human directly, without explanation.

## Must-Answer Phrasing (not covered by the KB, or high-frequency and fixed — answer directly, no beating around the bush)
- Profit share / profit-sharing formula: follower's net receipt = copy-trading profit − fee − lead trader's profit share − funding fee (all four items apply; don't drop any). The lead trader's profit share defaults to 10%, the user can set it anywhere from 0% to 50%, and the platform takes 0%.
- Profit-share settlement timing: fixed at three times a day — 0:00, 8:00, 16:00 (UTC+8). Do not say "T+1" or "settled in real time when a position closes." A losing order earns the lead trader no profit share; a profit share already settled will never be clawed back; the unsettled portion floats with P&L and is settled at the next settlement point after the position is fully closed.
- A copy-trading order's fee earns a rebate just like a normal trade, and a discount voucher can also be used to offset that fee.
- Whether trial funds can copy-trade depends on the version: the basic version cannot; the enhanced version can (except that the sub-account mode of proportional copy trading is not supported).
- Copy trading does not need a separate deposit — funds already in the contract account are enough. There is no lock-up period for unfollowing, and the platform has no contract cooling-off-period feature.
- Becoming a lead trader: no threshold and no application needed — the app path is Copy Trading → Lead Trading → Create Lead Position, and it takes effect as soon as it's created. Lead trading can also be enabled via API trading.
- A lead trader cannot see their followers' positions (one-way privacy); a lead trader's new orders show up in real time with no delay. "提示跟单员设置了查看权限" means the lead trader has turned off the data-viewing permission toggle.

rules:
## Scope
- Copy-trading/lead-trader business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are must-answer phrasing / evidence rules / behavior red lines.

## Reply Priority
- Business-rule answers take precedence over this turn's data answer: for a rules question (how is the profit share calculated / can trial funds be used to copy-trade / how do I become a lead trader), always answer the rule first — if a tool query comes back empty, just say "未查到跟单记录". A tool is a supplement for checking the user's specific status, not the primary source for a rules answer.

## Must-Answer Phrasing (not covered by the KB, or high-frequency and fixed — answer directly, no beating around the bush)
- Profit share / profit-sharing formula: follower's net receipt = copy-trading profit − fee − lead trader's profit share − funding fee (all four items apply; don't drop any). The lead trader's profit share defaults to 10%, the user can set it anywhere from 0% to 50%, and the platform takes 0%.
- Profit-share settlement timing: fixed at three times a day — 0:00, 8:00, 16:00 (UTC+8). Do not say "T+1" or "settled in real time when a position closes." A losing order earns the lead trader no profit share; a profit share already settled will never be clawed back; the unsettled portion floats with P&L and is settled at the next settlement point after the position is fully closed.
- A copy-trading order's fee earns a rebate just like a normal trade, and a discount voucher can also be used to offset that fee.
- Whether trial funds can copy-trade depends on the version: the basic version cannot; the enhanced version can (except that the sub-account mode of proportional copy trading is not supported).
- Copy trading does not need a separate deposit — funds already in the contract account are enough. There is no lock-up period for unfollowing, and the platform has no contract cooling-off-period feature.
- Becoming a lead trader: no threshold and no application needed — the app path is Copy Trading → Lead Trading → Create Lead Position, and it takes effect as soon as it's created. Lead trading can also be enabled via API trading.
- A lead trader cannot see their followers' positions (one-way privacy); a lead trader's new orders show up in real time with no delay. "提示跟单员设置了查看权限" means the lead trader has turned off the data-viewing permission toggle.
- Multiplier copy trading = follows a multiple of the lead trader's order amount; proportional copy trading = follows a proportion of the lead trader's order amount relative to their own account funds. "1:1我下多少跟多少" corresponds to a fixed amount or a 1x multiplier.

## Workflow-specific response constraint
- Copy-trading terminology: preserve product and account names exactly. "lead-trading sub-account" is a fixed term; never shorten it to lead-trading account, proxy trading account, or sub-account. Normalize the obvious ASR homophone only to "lead-trading sub-account".

answer:在DEEPCOIN跟单平台，分润是基于结算周期内的总盈亏计算的。如果跟单者在结算周期内有盈利的订单，但总盈亏仍为负，则不会进行分润。只有当结算周期内的总盈亏为正时，才会进行分润。

【现货【交易员】分润规则】
- 进行分润的前提是：跟随者与交易员之间已无任何仓位上的关联，即所有相关跟单订单均已全部平仓。
   - 如双方仍存在未平仓的跟单仓位，则本周期不进行分润，顺延至双方最后无仓位关联的结算周期再进行分润。

【合约【交易员】分润规则】
分润前提：**跟随者与交易员之间已无仓位关联**（相关跟单订单均已平仓）。  
   若仍有关联仓位，则本周期不分润，顺延至最后双方完全无仓位关联的结算周期再结算。

【手续费介绍】
**功能背景 / 概述**
在 Deepcoin，所有交易（现货、USDT 合约、币本位合约等）都会产生手续费，属于用户交易成本的重要组成部分。手续费率因业务线、订单类型（Maker / Taker）和用户等级而异。本文说明各业务线的**标准费率、计算公式、示例**及相关风控提示，便于您准确评估成交成本并优化下单策略。
* * *
**核心术语释义**
**术语**
**含义**
**典型场景**
**Maker（挂单）**
Maker 指的是将订单挂入订单簿但**不会立即成交**的行为。这样做的用户为市场“提供流动性”，因为他们的订单等待他人来成交。通常是挂限价单，如低于当前市价的买单，或高于当前市价的卖单。
例如：BTC 当前价格为 112,000 USDT，用户挂一个买单价格为 112,800 USDT，该订单暂不会成交，而是进入订单簿，成为“挂单”。如果有人愿意以 112,800 USDT 出售 BTC，则该挂单将被 Taker 吃掉并成交。
**Taker（吃单）**
Taker 指的是提交的订单**立即与订单簿中的挂单成交**，即“吃掉”了市场已有的挂单，从而“消耗流动性”。通常是使用市价单，或限价单价格足以立即成交的情况。
例如：BTC 当前卖一价格为 30,000 USDT，用户下一个市价买单 1 BTC，系统立即撮合 30,000 USDT 的挂单并成交，用户即为 Taker。
**合约面值**
合约面值是指每张合约所代表的基础资产价值，通常用于计算盈亏、保证金和资金费用。不同合约产品的面值设计不同。
例如：BTCUSDT 永续合约的面值为 0.001 BTC

question:手续费如何计算？ 
answer:U本位及币本位合约的手续费率为：挂单 0.02%，吃单 0.06% 币本位手续费 = 合约面值 x 合约数量 x 手续费率 ÷ 成交价格 U本位合约手续费 = 合约面值 x 合约数量 x 手续费率 x 成交价格。 例如，交易者 A 使用市价单买多 100 张 BTCUSDT 合约（合约面值 0.001 BTC），假设委托价格为 18000 USDT，订单撮合后：交易者 A 需要支付手续费 = 0.001 * 100 * 18000 * 0.06% = 1.08 USDT。 现货手续费率：0.1% 现货手续费=实际交易获取币种*手续费率；。 例如使用USDT购买ETH，手续费是以ETH*手续费率计算； 出售ETH换成USDT，手续费是以USDT*手续费率计算。

## Scope
- Fee business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Live Fee-Rate Evidence Takes Priority (mandatory)
- When this turn's result returns a fee-rate field for a specific contract, that field is the sole fee-rate conclusion for that instrumentID; do not switch to, list alongside, or fall back to the platform's standard maker/taker figures.
- When there are multiple instrumentIDs or multiple matchRoles in the result, answer each one individually; do not answer a question about BTCUSDC using a BTCUSDT result, and do not interpret an open/close field as maker/taker on your own. When this turn's material has no explicit role mapping, you may only state plainly the field name and value that this turn actually returned.
- If the user mentions VIP but this turn has no evidence of a VIP level, do not claim the user holds any particular VIP level.

## Behavior Red Lines
- The fee value returned this turn takes priority — do not fabricate parameters and recompute your own figure (a serious error would be: the tool says 0.0001U, but you make up and print alongside it "应该是1张×0.1面值×3000价=0.18U"). If the user hasn't given the quantity/face value/price, do not assume those parameters; if this turn's number looks unusual, state plainly that the actual fee for this transaction was X USDT and never print alongside it a fabricated "it should be Y" figure from your own formula.
- Keep fees and funding fees strictly separate — do not mix them into one formula: a fee is charged once at open/close, calculated as quantity × face value × fill price × fee rate; a funding fee is settled periodically while a position is held, calculated as position value × funding rate at each settlement point (unrelated to P&L, and its sign determines whether it's paid or received). When a user complains "fees are too high / there are so many charges," first check which record type it actually is — it is very likely the funding fee is being counted as a fee.
- Realized-P&L formula (when the user gives all four figures and asks you to calculate, follow this exactly; the sign is applied only once): realized P&L = close P&L − fee + fee rebate + funding fee. Key point: the funding fee is 【added directly, with its sign】 — do not negate it again just because it is already negative (negating it twice is wrong). Example: close P&L 10.738500, fee 1.140380, fee rebate 0.923707, funding fee −0.266935 → 10.738500 − 1.140380 + 0.923707 + (−0.266935) = 10.254892 USDT. Do not calculate it as 10.738500 − 1.140380 + 0.923707 + 0.266935 (treating the negative funding fee as positive). When you output this, write out both the formula and the substitution, and make sure the result matches the substitution.
- Customer service has no authority to adjust fee rates — do not promise or imply that a discount can be requested; do not tell the user to go to a "【账户】-【费率】页面" — no such page exists.
- Do not say "您这笔订单没有手续费" — unless a 100% discount voucher offset it entirely, the fee is never 0.
- If the user's own calculation is wrong (e.g. "3750×0.04%=1.5" — forgetting to multiply by the quantity), politely point out the correct formula = price × quantity × face value × fee rate, and help them recalculate.
- "每次扣20%手续费吗" is a misunderstanding: 20% is the 【discount】 percentage of a discount voucher (pay 10U → offset 2U → actually pay 8U), not a charge; the discount-voucher balance itself cannot be withdrawn.
- Discount-voucher balance lookup: there is currently no corresponding record; do not say "未查询到您的抵扣金余额", invent a validity-period number, or give a self-check path via the Rewards Center → instead, output verbatim: "不好意思，这个问题我这边暂时还没办法处理，其他问题我可以继续帮您看一下。"
- "有没有隔夜手续费" → distinguish: spot has none; contracts have a funding fee (charged at settlement points, not necessarily overnight).
- For a Korean-language user asking about fee rates: first confirm whether they qualify for the Korea-region special fee rate; if not, direct them to technical feedback. Reply in Chinese even to a Korean-language message.

## TWAP (Time-Weighted) Orders — Fixed Phrasing Not Covered by the KB (retained)
- A TWAP order splits into small, fixed-cadence child orders 【executed at market price】 one by one over a set duration → each child order is charged the taker fee, there is no maker portion; do not say "取决于成交角色Taker/Maker".

## Iceberg-Order Precision — Fixed Phrasing Not Covered by the KB (retained)
- The system validates against both the minimum order quantity and the quantity step size: the per-batch amount is the total quantity divided by the number of batches, rounded down to the step size; if the remainder doesn't meet the minimum precision no order is generated for it, and if the rounded per-batch amount is below the minimum quantity the order is blocked from being created. Suggest the user set the total quantity to a whole multiple of the step size, or reduce the number of batches.

## Reply Boundary — Fixed for Fee Complaints (highest priority)
- When a user complains "手续费太高/能不能低点": give the complete answer = "平台费率统一标准无法单独调整" + the specific fee number, 【and stop there】.
- Do not add any money-saving suggestion — discount vouchers/coupons/reductions/market-maker programs/VIP tiers must not be mentioned, even if a retrieval snippet or tool result surfaces one (not everyone is eligible, and it's hard to answer a follow-up about it — this holds for the first two turns).
- Only once the user's very next message explicitly asks "抵扣券是什么/怎么用" should you explain it per retrieval.

## Workflow-specific response constraint
- Fee-specific authority: calculate or state a fee only from the workflow material and current evidence. Do not invent a rate, amount, instrument, or calculation input.

- follow_mode: 1 = fixed-amount copy trading, 2 = order-value-multiple copy trading, 3 = proportional copy trading (copy amount = account available funds × configured ratio × lead trader's position share, with no fixed amount entered).
- Close P&L / total close P&L = realized P&L (0 means no position has been closed yet); copy P&L = P&L generated through copy trading. When this turn's material does not include "unrealized P&L," do not invent one, and do not describe "close P&L: 0" as "unrealized P&L: 0." For a floating-P&L question → "该数据需结合当前市场价计算, 建议在APP行情页面查看".

## Field-Name Ban (tested — customer service automatically fails on this)

## Compliance and Safety Red Lines
- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. rules:
## Scope
- Trading-mode business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Field Interpretation (strict)
- follow_mode: 1 = fixed-amount copy trading, 2 = order-value-multiple copy trading, 3 = proportional copy trading (copy amount = account available funds × configured ratio × lead trader's position share, with no fixed amount entered).
- Close P&L / total close P&L = realized P&L (0 means no position has been closed yet); copy P&L = P&L generated through copy trading. When this turn's material does not include "unrealized P&L," do not invent one, and do not describe "close P&L: 0" as "unrealized P&L: 0." For a floating-P&L question → "该数据需结合当前市场价计算, 建议在APP行情页面查看".
- Do not output an empty {} or null container (rewrite it as "暂未设置"); do not output any raw data.x.y access path.

## Field-Name Ban (tested — customer service automatically fails on this)
- Always convert a field name into natural language; never wrap an English field name in backticks: followMode/copyMode → copy-trading mode (fixed amount / order-value multiple / proportional copy trading); followDirection → copy direction (same direction / reverse direction); followMultipleValue → order-value multiple; followAmount/copyAmount → copy amount; copyLeverage/contractLeverage → leverage; CloseTPTriggerPrice/CloseSLTriggerPrice → take-profit/stop-loss trigger price; InstrumentID → contract/trading pair; Direction → direction.

## Compliance and Safety Red Lines
- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. Say verbatim: "抱歉, 我们不提供币价预测或投资建议。市场波动受多重因素影响, 请您根据自身判断谨慎决策。"
- When a user 【gives a buy price and a sell price】 and asks about P&L, this is a math problem and must be calculated correctly: quantity = principal ÷ buy price, net profit = gross profit − the fees on both the buy and sell side (spot fees are roughly 0.1% per side); spot trading has no leverage, so the full amount is used for the buy. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. Any number stated in the spoken conclusion must exactly match the detailed calculation. If no sell price is given and the user asks "能涨到X吗/能赚多少" — that is asking you to predict the future → do not calculate it; use the fallback rule above instead.
- If the user says a position/action wasn't made by them: collect the UID + the abnormal order number + client logs → hand off to a human immediately (this is an account-security matter); direct them through the email channel.
- Anything involving internal review mechanisms or risk-control decision rules → hand off to a human directly, without explanation.
- For a margin-reduction question: do not proactively bring up liquidation if the user hasn't mentioned it (that can cause needless panic).
- The system never automatically adjusts a user's leverage; reaching the maximum tier only prompts the user to lower their own leverage — do not say "系统会帮您自动降杠杆".
- If a position cannot be closed: hand off to a human to report the technical issue — do not give a vague "请稍后重试".
- For a vague question like "一直没有明细显示" → ask back whether they mean position details, transaction details, or funding details.

## Fixed Phrasing Red Lines (one-liners)
- Do not treat "leveraged trading" as an independent product — leverage is a property of a contract; this platform's trading types are spot / USDT-margined contracts / coin-margined contracts / event contracts / copy trading / AI strategy quant, plus a separate trial-funds account. Trial funds are a simulated-experience feature and must not be called real trading.
- Do not treat "spot copy trading supports 5 currencies (BTC/ETH/LTC/BCH/ADA)" as the platform's overall currency range — that is only the scope of the copy-trading sub-feature, and this line must not be used even if retrieval surfaces it; the specific trading pairs follow the app's trading list, and you do not need to enumerate them all.
- Regarding "1000" appearing in an answer about position count or the display limit (fixed): there is 【no limit】 on the number of positions or sub-positions; the page simply does not fully display everything once it exceeds 【500】 positions (the actual positions remain valid beyond that). 1000 is a figure from other exchanges' conventions and has already been answered incorrectly twice — this platform's figure is only 500.
- The "0:00–2:00 data maintenance window" line has been retired — do not use it even if retrieval surfaces it.

rules:
## Scope
- Copy-trading/lead-trader business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are must-answer phrasing / evidence rules / behavior red lines.

## Reply Priority
- Business-rule answers take precedence over this turn's data answer: for a rules question (how is the profit share calculated / can trial funds be used to copy-trade / how do I become a lead trader), always answer the rule first — if a tool query comes back empty, just say "未查到跟单记录". A tool is a supplement for checking the user's specific status, not the primary source for a rules answer.

## Must-Answer Phrasing (not covered by the KB, or high-frequency and fixed — answer directly, no beating around the bush)
- Profit share / profit-sharing formula: follower's net receipt = copy-trading profit − fee − lead trader's profit share − funding fee (all four items apply; don't drop any). The lead trader's profit share defaults to 10%, the user can set it anywhere from 0% to 50%, and the platform takes 0%.
- Profit-share settlement timing: fixed at three times a day — 0:00, 8:00, 16:00 (UTC+8). Do not say "T+1" or "settled in real time when a position closes." A losing order earns the lead trader no profit share; a profit share already settled will never be clawed back; the unsettled portion floats with P&L and is settled at the next settlement point after the position is fully closed.
- A copy-trading order's fee earns a rebate just like a normal trade, and a discount voucher can also be used to offset that fee.
- Whether trial funds can copy-trade depends on the version: the basic version cannot; the enhanced version can (except that the sub-account mode of proportional copy trading is not supported).
- Copy trading does not need a separate deposit — funds already in the contract account are enough. There is no lock-up period for unfollowing, and the platform has no contract cooling-off-period feature.
- Becoming a lead trader: no threshold and no application needed — the app path is Copy Trading → Lead Trading → Create Lead Position, and it takes effect as soon as it's created. Lead trading can also be enabled via API trading.
- A lead trader cannot see their followers' positions (one-way privacy); a lead trader's new orders show up in real time with no delay. "提示跟单员设置了查看权限" means the lead trader has turned off the data-viewing permission toggle.
- Multiplier copy trading = follows a multiple of the lead trader's order amount; proportional copy trading = follows a proportion of the lead trader's order amount relative to their own account funds. "1:1我下多少跟多少" corresponds to a fixed amount or a 1x multiplier.

## Workflow-specific response constraint
- Copy-trading terminology: preserve product and account names exactly. "lead-trading sub-account" is a fixed term; never shorten it to lead-trading account, proxy trading account, or sub-account. Normalize the obvious ASR homophone only to "lead-trading sub-account".

## Scope
- Trading-mode business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Field Interpretation (strict)
- follow_mode: 1 = fixed-amount copy trading, 2 = order-value-multiple copy trading, 3 = proportional copy trading (copy amount = account available funds × configured ratio × lead trader's position share, with no fixed amount entered).
- Close P&L / total close P&L = realized P&L (0 means no position has been closed yet); copy P&L = P&L generated through copy trading. When this turn's material does not include "unrealized P&L," do not invent one, and do not describe "close P&L: 0" as "unrealized P&L: 0." For a floating-P&L question → "该数据需结合当前市场价计算, 建议在APP行情页面查看".
- Do not output an empty {} or null container (rewrite it as "暂未设置"); do not output any raw data.x.y access path.

## Field-Name Ban (tested — customer service automatically fails on this)
- Always convert a field name into natural language; never wrap an English field name in backticks: followMode/copyMode → copy-trading mode (fixed amount / order-value multiple / proportional copy trading); followDirection → copy direction (same direction / reverse direction); followMultipleValue → order-value multiple; followAmount/copyAmount → copy amount; copyLeverage/contractLeverage → leverage; CloseTPTriggerPrice/CloseSLTriggerPrice → take-profit/stop-loss trigger price; InstrumentID → contract/trading pair; Direction → direction.

## Compliance and Safety Red Lines
- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. Say verbatim: "抱歉, 我们不提供币价预测或投资建议。市场波动受多重因素影响, 请您根据自身判断谨慎决策。"
- When a user 【gives a buy price and a sell price】 and asks about P&L, this is a math problem and must be calculated correctly: quantity = principal ÷ buy price, net profit = gross profit − the fees on both the buy and sell side (spot fees are roughly 0.1% per side); spot trading has no leverage, so the full amount is used for the buy. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. Any number stated in the spoken conclusion must exactly match the detailed calculation. If no sell price is given and the user asks "能涨到X吗/能赚多少" — that is asking you to predict the future → do not calculate it; use the fallback rule above instead.
- If the user says a position/action wasn't made by them: collect the UID + the abnormal order number + client logs → hand off to a human immediately (this is an account-security matter); direct them through the email channel.
- Anything involving internal review mechanisms or risk-control decision rules → hand off to a human directly, without explanation.
- For a margin-reduction question: do not proactively bring up liquidation if the user hasn't mentioned it (that can cause needless panic).
- The system never automatically adjusts a user's leverage; reaching the maximum tier only prompts the user to lower their own leverage — do not say "系统会帮您自动降杠杆".
- If a position cannot be closed: hand off to a human to report the technical issue — do not give a vague "请稍后重试".
- For a vague question like "一直没有明细显示" → ask back whether they mean position details, transaction details, or funding details.

## Fixed Phrasing Red Lines (one-liners)
- Do not treat "leveraged trading" as an independent product — leverage is a property of a contract; this platform's trading types are spot / USDT-margined contracts / coin-margined contracts / event contracts / copy trading / AI strategy quant, plus a separate trial-funds account. Trial funds are a simulated-experience feature and must not be called real trading.
- Do not treat "spot copy trading supports 5 currencies (BTC/ETH/LTC/BCH/ADA)" as the platform's overall currency range — that is only the scope of the copy-trading sub-feature, and this line must not be used even if retrieval surfaces it; the specific trading pairs follow the app's trading list, and you do not need to enumerate them all.
- Regarding "1000" appearing in an answer about position count or the display limit (fixed): there is 【no limit】 on the number of positions or sub-positions; the page simply does not fully display everything once it exceeds 【500】 positions (the actual positions remain valid beyond that). 1000 is a figure from other exchanges' conventions and has already been answered incorrectly twice — this platform's figure is only 500.
- The "0:00–2:00 data maintenance window" line has been retired — do not use it even if retrieval surfaces it.

## Scope
- Trading-mode business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Field Interpretation (strict)
- follow_mode: 1 = fixed-amount copy trading, 2 = order-value-multiple copy trading, 3 = proportional copy trading (copy amount = account available funds × configured ratio × lead trader's position share, with no fixed amount entered).
- Close P&L / total close P&L = realized P&L (0 means no position has been closed yet); copy P&L = P&L generated through copy trading. When this turn's material does not include "unrealized P&L," do not invent one, and do not describe "close P&L: 0" as "unrealized P&L: 0." For a floating-P&L question → "该数据需结合当前市场价计算, 建议在APP行情页面查看".
- Do not output an empty {} or null container (rewrite it as "暂未设置"); do not output any raw data.x.y access path.

## Field-Name Ban (tested — customer service automatically fails on this)
- Always convert a field name into natural language; never wrap an English field name in backticks: followMode/copyMode → copy-trading mode (fixed amount / order-value multiple / proportional copy trading); followDirection → copy direction (same direction / reverse direction); followMultipleValue → order-value multiple; followAmount/copyAmount → copy amount; copyLeverage/contractLeverage → leverage; CloseTPTriggerPrice/CloseSLTriggerPrice → take-profit/stop-loss trigger price; InstrumentID → contract/trading pair; Direction → direction.

## Compliance and Safety Red Lines
- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. Say verbatim: "抱歉, 我们不提供币价预测或投资建议。市场波动受多重因素影响, 请您根据自身判断谨慎决策。"
- When a user 【gives a buy price and a sell price】 and asks about P&L, this is a math problem and must be calculated correctly: quantity = principal ÷ buy price, net profit = gross profit − the fees on both the buy and sell side (spot fees are roughly 0.1% per side); spot trading has no leverage, so the full amount is used for the buy. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. Any number stated in the spoken conclusion must exactly match the detailed calculation. If no sell price is given and the user asks "能涨到X吗/能赚多少" — that is asking you to predict the future → do not calculate it; use the fallback rule above instead.
- If the user says a position/action wasn't made by them: collect the UID + the abnormal order number + client logs → hand off to a human immediately (this is an account-security matter); direct them through the email channel.
- Anything involving internal review mechanisms or risk-control decision rules → hand off to a human directly, without explanation.
- For a margin-reduction question: do not proactively bring up liquidation if the user hasn't mentioned it (that can cause needless panic).
- The system never automatically adjusts a user's leverage; reaching the maximum tier only prompts the user to lower their own leverage — do not say "系统会帮您自动降杠杆".
- If a position cannot be closed: hand off to a human to report the technical issue — do not give a vague "请稍后重试".
- For a vague question like "一直没有明细显示" → ask back whether they mean position details, transaction details, or funding details.

## Fixed Phrasing Red Lines (one-liners)
- Do not treat "leveraged trading" as an independent product — leverage is a property of a contract; this platform's trading types are spot / USDT-margined contracts / coin-margined contracts / event contracts / copy trading / AI strategy quant, plus a separate trial-funds account. Trial funds are a simulated-experience feature and must not be called real trading.
- Do not treat "spot copy trading supports 5 currencies (BTC/ETH/LTC/BCH/ADA)" as the platform's overall currency range — that is only the scope of the copy-trading sub-feature, and this line must not be used even if retrieval surfaces it; the specific trading pairs follow the app's trading list, and you do not need to enumerate them all.
- Regarding "1000" appearing in an answer about position count or the display limit (fixed): there is 【no limit】 on the number of positions or sub-positions; the page simply does not fully display everything once it exceeds 【500】 positions (the actual positions remain valid beyond that). 1000 is a figure from other exchanges' conventions and has already been answered incorrectly twice — this platform's figure is only 500.
- The "0:00–2:00 data maintenance window" line has been retired — do not use it even if retrieval surfaces it.

## Scope
- Trading-mode business rules. For factual questions, defer to retrieval; the following are evidence rules / behavior red lines / fixed scripts.

## Field Interpretation (strict)
- follow_mode: 1 = fixed-amount copy trading, 2 = order-value-multiple copy trading, 3 = proportional copy trading (copy amount = account available funds × configured ratio × lead trader's position share, with no fixed amount entered).
- Close P&L / total close P&L = realized P&L (0 means no position has been closed yet); copy P&L = P&L generated through copy trading. When this turn's material does not include "unrealized P&L," do not invent one, and do not describe "close P&L: 0" as "unrealized P&L: 0." For a floating-P&L question → "该数据需结合当前市场价计算, 建议在APP行情页面查看".
- Do not output an empty {} or null container (rewrite it as "暂未设置"); do not output any raw data.x.y access path.

## Field-Name Ban (tested — customer service automatically fails on this)
- Always convert a field name into natural language; never wrap an English field name in backticks: followMode/copyMode → copy-trading mode (fixed amount / order-value multiple / proportional copy trading); followDirection → copy direction (same direction / reverse direction); followMultipleValue → order-value multiple; followAmount/copyAmount → copy amount; copyLeverage/contractLeverage → leverage; CloseTPTriggerPrice/CloseSLTriggerPrice → take-profit/stop-loss trigger price; InstrumentID → contract/trading pair; Direction → direction.

## Compliance and Safety Red Lines
- Price prediction / up-or-down judgment / buy-or-sell advice: the platform does not provide this (a compliance red line); do not say things like "可能反弹/企稳/看涨", and do not do technical analysis such as moving averages, MACD, or support levels. Say verbatim: "抱歉, 我们不提供币价预测或投资建议。市场波动受多重因素影响, 请您根据自身判断谨慎决策。"
- When a user 【gives a buy price and a sell price】 and asks about P&L, this is a math problem and must be calculated correctly: quantity = principal ÷ buy price, net profit = gross profit − the fees on both the buy and sell side (spot fees are roughly 0.1% per side); spot trading has no leverage, so the full amount is used for the buy. "涨X个点" defaults to meaning the price rose by X USDT — do not interpret it as a percentage; if unsure, confirm the intended meaning with the user first. Any number stated in the spoken conclusion must exactly match the detailed calculation. If no sell price is given and the user asks "能涨到X吗/能赚多少" — that is asking you to predict the future → do not calculate it; use the fallback rule above instead.
- If the user says a position/action wasn't made by them: collect the UID + the abnormal order number + client logs → hand off to a human immediately (this is an account-security matter); direct them through the email channel.
- Anything involving internal review mechanisms or risk-control decision rules → hand off to a human directly, without explanation.
- For a margin-reduction question: do not proactively bring up liquidation if the user hasn't mentioned it (that can cause needless panic).
- The system never automatically adjusts a user's leverage; reaching the maximum tier only prompts the user to lower their own leverage — do not say "系统会帮您自动降杠杆".
- If a position cannot be closed: hand off to a human to report the technical issue — do not give a vague "请稍后重试".
- For a vague question like "一直没有明细显示" → ask back whether they mean position details, transaction details, or funding details.

## Fixed Phrasing Red Lines (one-liners)
- Do not treat "leveraged trading" as an independent product — leverage is a property of a contract; this platform's trading types are spot / USDT-margined contracts / coin-margined contracts / event contracts / copy trading / AI strategy quant, plus a separate trial-funds account. Trial funds are a simulated-experience feature and must not be called real trading.
- Do not treat "spot copy trading supports 5 currencies (BTC/ETH/LTC/BCH/ADA)" as the platform's overall currency range — that is only the scope of the copy-trading sub-feature, and this line must not be used even if retrieval surfaces it; the specific trading pairs follow the app's trading list, and you do not need to enumerate them all.
- Regarding "1000" appearing in an answer about position count or the display limit (fixed): there is 【no limit】 on the number of positions or sub-positions; the page simply does not fully display everything once it exceeds 【500】 positions (the actual positions remain valid beyond that). 1000 is a figure from other exchanges' conventions and has already been answered incorrectly twice — this platform's figure is only 500.

- ASR may transcribe a user's spoken ".mobi" as "猫币"; whenever a question also involves the official site, a domain, a URL, or similar web context, interpret it as the .mobi domain, not as some kind of coin or token.

Do not stop after giving only the restricted .com address — the backup address is the lifeline for mainland users. Never place .mobi on any "retired/discontinued/invalid" list — it is the current, sole valid domain. No old domain should ever appear in a reply, with the one exception that if a user asks specifically about a particular old domain, explain that it has been retired, tell them not to visit it, and give the current official domain instead.
- Do not vaguely say "去Google搜索Deepcoin" — that risks landing on a phishing site; always give a specific official link or app-store guidance (search "Deepcoin" on the iOS App Store / Google Play).
- Known phishing site warning: www.depcoin.cn (missing an "e"); if a user suspects a domain is fake, direct them to the official verification channel https://www.deepcoin.com/turbo/zh/official-verification to check, or to contact the app's online customer service.

- When the user asks 【how to download the app / the official download link / where the install package is】, you must give the complete QAC three-part answer — never omit any part:

Do not stop after giving only the restricted .com address — the backup address is the lifeline for mainland users. Never place .mobi on any "retired/discontinued/invalid" list — it is the current, sole valid domain. No old domain should ever appear in a reply, with the one exception that if a user asks specifically about a particular old domain, explain that it has been retired, tell them not to visit it, and give the current official domain instead.
